items.text: These Are Broad Patterns, Not These Are Broad Patterns, Not These are broad patterns, not a claim that every provider in a category behaves identically. Use the table to see what each channel typically gives you, then check the specific option you are weighing against it.

items.text: Online Guidance Platforms Remove Online guidance platforms remove the "whoever happens to be nearby" limit entirely, since the session runs the same way regardless of your city.

items.heading: An Independent Private Counsellor
items.text: An independent private counsellor can offer strong personal attention, but quality and follow-up structure vary a lot from one person to the next.

items.heading: The Right Channel Is Not
items.text: The right channel is not the closest or cheapest one by default - it's the one whose depth matches how big the decision actually is.
